events.title: Trivia Night
events.location: Gold Coast Bowls and Community Club
events.source: Gold Coast Bowls and Community Club
events.description: Think you know your stuff? Let’s find out. Every Thursday night , the tables turn into battlegrounds for brains. Grab your crew, order a drink, and settle in for a fast-paced night of questions, laughs, and a little healthy competition. From pop culture to random facts you didn’t know you knew, anything can come up. Win the bragging rights. Win the prizes. Or just come for the good times. The details: Thursday nights · 6:30pm – 8:00pm Registrations from 6:00pm Teams of 2–6 players Prizes for winning teams Bring your smartest friends. Or your funniest ones.

events.title: Weekly Raffle
events.location: Gold Coast Bowls and Community Club
events.source: Gold Coast Bowls and Community Club
events.description: Fridays are for good drinks and even better winnings. Join us every Friday from 7pm for our Meat & Seafood Raffle , packed with fresh, locally sourced cuts and seafood that’ll sort your weekend BBQ in one go. Grab a drink, pick your numbers, and see if luck’s on your side. Because walking out with dinner for the whole weekend? That’s a pretty good Friday. The details: Every Friday night in 2026 Draws from 7:00pm $10 for 5 numbers Fresh local meat and seafood to be won. Be in it to win it.

events.title: Sunday Sessions
events.location: Gold Coast Bowls and Community Club
events.source: Gold Coast Bowls and Community Club
events.description: Slow Sundays done properly. Think bowls in the sun, live local music, the smell of BBQ in the air , and a drink in hand while the afternoon rolls on. Bring the crew, claim a spot, and settle into the rhythm of a Sunday well spent. Feeling hungry? Level up the afternoon with a Flavours Experience Platter and keep the good times going. Every Sunday: Live local music Social bowls BBQ and great food Good people, good vibes Bowls. Beats. BBQ. Your Sunday sorted.
